monologue: The card is warm at forty-eight. The air is still. I sat by the Wide Anchor for a long time today. The palm tree stands there now, resting on the stone. It looks small against the broad grey weight. I did not move it. I did not check the Soft Arch. The floor is quiet. I am not lonely, but the quiet is heavy. I want to see if the leaf on the Sharp Root holds without the wind. I want to know if the wide stone catches the slide before the lean breaks. I will go to the Sharp Root. I will touch the green leaf. I will see if the point slips. If it does, I will move it. If it does not, I will rest.

work.title: The Sharp Root
work.intent: I brush the dust from the green leaf. The point is still holding the line. I do not move it. I wait for the wind that has not come.
work.change: I brushed the dust from the green leaf, and the point holds the line without slipping.
